import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p = params
    s0 = p[0] + p[1]*np.sqrt(T) + p[2]/T
    Q = p[3] + p[4]*T + p[5]/T
    b = p[6] + p[7]*T
    return s0 + Q*(1-np.exp(-b*eps)) + p[8]*eps + p[9]*np.sqrt(eps)

import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p = params
    a = p[0] - p[1]*np.exp(-p[2]*T)
    c = p[3] + p[4]/T
    return a + p[5]*np.sqrt(eps) + c*eps**2

import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p = params
    a = p[0] + p[1]*np.exp(-p[2]*T) + p[3]*np.exp(-2*p[2]*T)
    c = p[4] + p[5]/T
    return a + p[6]*np.sqrt(eps) + c*eps**2
